message.frozendawn.freeze.biting: The cold is biting into you...
message.frozendawn.freeze.extreme: Extreme cold! Find shelter or warmth!
message.frozendawn.suffocate.lightheaded: You feel lightheaded... the air is thinning.
message.frozendawn.suffocate.nausea: Your vision swims. You can't breathe.
message.frozendawn.suffocate.fading: Your limbs go numb. Everything is fading...
message.frozendawn.suffocate.dying: There is no air. You are suffocating.
command.frozendawn.preset.locked: World difficulty is locked. Use operator access to override it.
message.frozendawn.difficulty.locked: This world's difficulty is already locked.
screen.frozendawn.difficulty.title: FROZEN DAWN DIFFICULTY
screen.frozendawn.difficulty.subtitle: Choose the world preset.
screen.frozendawn.difficulty.default_not: DEFAULT is preselected when this prompt opens.
screen.frozendawn.difficulty.handbook: Refer to the ORSA handbook for more information.
screen.frozendawn.difficulty.lock_notice: Once selected, normal players cannot change this world difficulty.
screen.frozendawn.difficulty.default.lin: %s days. Standard collapse pace and baseline cold.
Normal snow, sanity drain, spawn pressure, and heater strength.
screen.frozendawn.difficulty.cinematic.l: %s days. Slower collapse and milder late-world cold.
Stronger heaters. Half snow, sanity drain, and spawn pressure.
screen.frozendawn.difficulty.brutal.line: %s days. Fast collapse and %s°C phase-5 cold.
Weaker heaters. Double snow, sanity drain, and spawn pressure.
advancement.frozendawn.root.title: The Sun Grows Cold
advancement.frozendawn.root.description: The apocalypse has begun. Earth drifts from its star.
advancement.frozendawn.phase2.title: A Dying World
advancement.frozendawn.phase2.descriptio: Phase 2: Water freezes and vegetation begins to die.
advancement.frozendawn.phase3.title: The Long Night
advancement.frozendawn.phase3.descriptio: Phase 3: Permanent storms rage. The surface grows lethal.
advancement.frozendawn.phase4.title: Deep Freeze
advancement.frozendawn.phase4.descriptio: Phase 4: Even the earth itself freezes solid.
advancement.frozendawn.phase5.title: Eternal Winter
advancement.frozendawn.phase5.descriptio: Phase 5: The sun is a distant memory. Only the deep earth holds warmth.
advancement.frozendawn.phase6.title: The Last Breath
advancement.frozendawn.phase6.descriptio: Phase 6: The atmosphere freezes and collapses. There is no air left to breathe. ...did you need oxygen?
advancement.frozendawn.last_light.title: Last Light
advancement.frozendawn.last_light.descri: Place a Geothermal Core below Y=0. The thermal anchor holds.
advancement.frozendawn.classified_inform: Discover an ORSA document. What did they do?
advancement.frozendawn.insulated_clothin: Equip a full set of insulated clothing. Fashion? No. Survival? Barely.
Equip a full set of heated insulation. You're basically a walking furnace.
advancement.frozendawn.eva_suit.title: One Small Step
advancement.frozendawn.eva_suit.descript: Equip a full EVA suit. Space called. You answered.
message.frozendawn.nether_severed: The dimensional link is dead. The Nether is unreachable.
advancement.frozendawn.nether_severed.de: Attempt to light a portal after Phase 5. No way out now.
message.frozendawn.frostbite.spreading: The cold is spreading up your arms!
message.frozendawn.frostbite.severe: Frostbite! You can barely hold anything!
message.frozendawn.frostbite.inventory: There's something very cold in your inventory...
message.frozendawn.frostbite.inventory_s: Your pack is radiating cold. It's seeping through.
The cold from your pack is unbearable!
message.frozendawn.heat.sweating: You're sweating... in a frozen apocalypse. Really?
message.frozendawn.heat.unbearable: The heat is unbearable! Maybe fewer heaters?
message.frozendawn.heat.cooking: You are literally cooking alive. In an ice age.
death.attack.frozendawn.hyperthermia: %1$s was cooked alive by their own heaters
advancement.frozendawn.too_hot_to_handle: Overheat in a world that's freezing to death. The irony is not lost on you.
advancement.frozendawn.insulation_both_w: Overheat while wearing insulated armor near your own heaters. You marinated yourself.
advancement.frozendawn.found_villager_jo: Find a villager's journal in the ruins.
advancement.frozendawn.found_orsa_bullet: Discover an ORSA Public Safety Bulletin.
advancement.frozendawn.found_vasik_log.d: Find Dr. Vasik's personal research log.
advancement.frozendawn.found_incident_re: Uncover ORSA Technical Incident Report TIR-2042-1171. Now you know everything.
advancement.frozendawn.food_spoiled.desc: Watch helplessly as your food freezes beyond recovery. Should've packed a lunchbox.
advancement.frozendawn.thermal_container: Craft a Thermal Container. Your lunch is now rated for deep space.
advancement.frozendawn.first_shard.title: Cold to the Touch
advancement.frozendawn.first_shard.descr: Pick up an Acheronite Shard. Your fingers regret this already.
advancement.frozendawn.acheron_forge_cra: Craft an Acheron Forge. ORSA R&D would be proud. Or horrified.
Equip a full set of Acheronite armor. You are now the thing everyone is afraid of.
advancement.frozendawn.lined_eva.title: Best of Both Worlds
advancement.frozendawn.lined_eva.descrip: Craft an Acheronite-Lined EVA Suit. Space-rated AND frostbite-proof. ORSA engineers wept.
advancement.frozendawn.frostbitten.title: Should've Worn Gloves
advancement.frozendawn.frostbitten.descr: Take frostbite damage from holding an Acheronite Shard. The warning was right there.
message.frozendawn.shard_sublimated: The shard evaporates in the warmth...
advancement.frozendawn.found_satellite_l: Find the crashed ORSA relay satellite. It came down hard.
advancement.frozendawn.found_launch_mani: Archive the ORSA launch manifest from the blast pit. The numbers do not add up.
advancement.frozendawn.found_transponder: Archive the ORSA Transponder Schematic. Now build the damn thing.
advancement.frozendawn.broadcast_complet: Complete the transponder broadcast. Someone out there heard you.
message.frozendawn.transponder.activated: Transponder online. Broadcasting signal... ETA: %s minutes.
message.frozendawn.transponder.paused_co: PAUSED — No Geothermal Core detected. %s minutes remaining.
message.frozendawn.transponder.paused_sh: PAUSED — Shaft blocked. Clear the path to the sky. %s minutes remaining.
message.frozendawn.transponder.complete: Broadcast complete. The signal has been sent.
message.frozendawn.transponder.too_high: The transponder must be placed below Y=0 to reach the deep relay network.
message.frozendawn.transponder.no_schema: You haven't found the transponder schematic yet.
message.frozendawn.transponder.no_core: No Geothermal Core detected nearby. The transponder needs a power source.
message.frozendawn.transponder.no_shaft: Signal blocked. The transponder needs a clear vertical shaft to the sky.
message.frozendawn.transponder.disabled: The win condition system is disabled. The transponder is non-functional.
tooltip.frozendawn.stuffed_hyrax: Closest living relative of the elephant. Somehow.
advancement.frozendawn.architect_noticed: Why is it looking at me like that
advancement.frozendawn.architect_singlep: I thought I was in singleplayer
message.frozendawn.sanity.watched: You feel like you are being watched...
death.attack.frozendawn.frostbitten: %1$s was frozen solid by a Frostbitten
message.frozendawn.capacitor.installed: Thermal Capacitor installed! Warmth radius doubled.
message.frozendawn.capacitor.already_ins: This heater already has a Thermal Capacitor.
advancement.frozendawn.later_casper.desc: Cause a Hollow to flee from a Frost Ward Torch. Who's haunting who now?
Burn frozen ghost breath to heat your base. ORSA Thermodynamics Division has concerns.
message.frozendawn.remnant_ember.burned_: Your Remnant Ember has burned out.
advancement.frozendawn.they_remember.des: A Returned extinguished your heater. They still know what fire does.
advancement.frozendawn.returned_killed.d: Kill one of the Returned. Whatever they were, they're at peace now.
tooltip.frozendawn.mirrored_fragment: A shard that shows a face not your own.
message.frozendawn.mirrored_fragment.use: The fragment shatters. Your mind clears.
death.attack.frozendawn.mimic: %1$s was killed by a Returned Mimic
advancement.frozendawn.not_a_shadow.desc: You've learned to stop ignoring the shapes in the dark.
tooltip.frozendawn.architect_soul: A frozen human will wrapped in geometry.
tooltip.frozendawn.architect_soul.use: Can be fused with an Acheronite Blade.
tooltip.frozendawn.architect_mask: A trophy cut from the cold's engineer.
tooltip.frozendawn.architect_mask.flavor: ORSA recommends not asking what, exactly, is still looking back.
tooltip.frozendawn.surveyor_lens: A reclaimed optic tuned to thermal anchors.
tooltip.frozendawn.surveyor_lens.use: Hold or offhand for passive thermal vision. Right-click to ping nearby signatures.
tooltip.frozendawn.calibrated_surveyor_l: A field optic recalibrated to cut through thermal clutter.
Hold or offhand for expanded thermal vision. Right-click to prioritize major signatures over ambient heat.
tooltip.frozendawn.orsa_thermal_visor: A helmet-mounted thermal array with a scavenged emergency rebreather.
tooltip.frozendawn.orsa_thermal_visor.us: Wear for hands-free thermal vision and +20C cold resistance.
tooltip.frozendawn.orsa_thermal_visor.o2: Paired with an EVA body rig, it halves O2 drain and buys extra breaths in vacuum.
tooltip.frozendawn.orsa_thermal_visor.mo: Press V to boot full thermal imaging mode and the ORSA visor interface.
tooltip.frozendawn.soul_harvest_blade: Soul Harvesting: +3 damage against Frozen Dawn hostiles.
tooltip.frozendawn.soul_harvest_blade.fl: The blade remembers what the dead were building.
message.frozendawn.surveyor_lens.detecte: %1$s thermal signatures. Primary: %2$s %3$s blocks away to the %4$s.
death.attack.frozendawn.architect: %1$s was disassembled by a Returned Architect
advancement.frozendawn.disassembled.desc: Kill a Returned Architect. It was taking your base apart with purpose.
advancement.frozendawn.found_newspaper_c: Find a tattered newspaper clipping. Some stories age poorly.
Find a crumpled newsletter page. 204 issues. 12 subscribers.
advancement.frozendawn.found_newspaper_w: Find a faded weather page. She went with the European model.
advancement.frozendawn.found_newspaper_m: Find a torn community board flyer. 26 names on the board.
advancement.frozendawn.et_tu_frosty.desc: He was never on your side.
advancement.frozendawn.stubborn.title: Stubborn
advancement.frozendawn.stubborn.descript: The simulation didn't account for this.
advancement.frozendawn.how.title: How.
message.frozendawn.ee.karman: The Karman line is lower than you'd think.
message.frozendawn.ee.stubborn: You weren't supposed to survive this long.
message.frozendawn.ee.fire_safety: ORSA Fire Safety Division would like a word.
